interpretation:
Phase 44 performs a multi-channel joint fit across SPARC, JVAS, and Cloud-9 constraints. The channels have conflicting requirements on sigma/m at different velocities:
  - SPARC wants sigma/m(100) ~ 0.07 cm^2/g
  - JVAS B1938+666 wants sigma/m(15) ~ 100 cm^2/g
  - Cloud-9 wants sigma/m(28) ~ 100 cm^2/g
  - Fornax/Tri II (dwarfs at v=15) wants sigma/m(15) < 5

These cannot all be satisfied with a single velocity-resonance. The joint fit either:
  - Finds a compromise (worse fit to all channels)
  - Or keeps one channel as outlier (no improvement)
